signal.positive_semantics: Fundamental Value ranks player above Market Value V2; prospective buy-low direction
signal.negative_semantics: Market Value V2 ranks player above Fundamental Value; prospective sell-high direction

future_market_snapshot_policy.selection: closest eligible snapshot to target elapsed days within frozen tolerance; ties choose later snapshot
future_market_snapshot_policy.no_substitution: snapshots outside the target window remain pending

primary_market_outcome.primary_metric: Spearman(global FV-market gap, future market percentile change)
primary_market_outcome.directional_metric: fraction whose future market movement has same sign as origin gap among abs(gap)>=0.10
primary_market_outcome.benchmark: generic market mean reversion predictor = 0.5 - origin market percentile
primary_market_outcome.cohort_spread: mean future percentile change of buy cohort minus sell cohort
primary_market_outcome.position_robustness: count of positions with positive gap-to-change Spearman among positions with n>=25

secondary_realized_production_test.method: sum fantasy points over the future horizon; convert totals to within-position percentiles; compare origin within-position FV-market gap with future production percentile minus origin within-position market percentile
secondary_realized_production_test.missing_week_player_semantics: zero fantasy points for that player-week
secondary_realized_production_test.reason_nonprimary: short-window fantasy production is noisy and availability-sensitive; it may support interpretation but cannot rescue failed market-movement gates

governance: Do not tune thresholds, cohorts, horizons, or gates after baseline freeze.
Do not use 1w or 2w results to alter the 4w protocol.
Do not deploy player recommendations from this study directly.
Do not change Fundamental Value, Market Value V2, Team Utility, or trade verdict math.
Named-player results are interpretation examples only and cannot determine pass/fail.
